events.text:
All 10 batches are migrated: 400 records in the new CRM.

**Issue:** Batch 3 validation noted that the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM prefixed them with +1. 31 of the first 120 records are overseas customers, so those numbers are wrong. Batches 4–10 were expected to have the same problem. I do not have corrected numbers, so I did not change any phones.

**Impact:** 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so wrong numbers may already be in use.

**Next step:** Hold outbound calls on migrated numbers until overseas phones are corrected from the old CRM.
